instruction: Refer to sheet_panel.step. For this task, open the part in FreeCAD from `/usr/bin/freecad`, then carry out the Path workbench edits when working on `sheet_panel.step`. Create a FreeCAD Path/CAM 2D Profile cutting Job. Machine the internal rectangular windows and circular holes as inside profiles before cutting the outside profile. Approximate the tool diameter from the 0.15 mm kerf setting. Cutting setup: use T1 for the 2D Profile operation and approximate the cutter from the 0.15 mm kerf requirement. Use the Job, stock/setup, origin, ToolBit/ToolController, operation, toolpath verification, and Path postprocessor dialogs as needed. Post the required G-code/NC output file(s) to the output folder using exactly these absolute file paths: /home/user/Desktop/task-10.gcode.
